subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `commentary` as a fourth persisted `/verbose` preset, including its suppression of tool-class operational and failure-detail messages?
rationale: This introduces a new public command, config, persistence, gateway, TUI, ACP, and Control UI contract whose permanent semantics require maintainer product intent.

options.title: Adopt the preset
options.body: Approve `commentary` as the global narration-only mode and require a conflict-free branch, documented composition rules, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep three levels
options.body: Decline the new persisted value and leave narration presentation owned by channel-specific progress configuration.

recommendation.title: Adopt the preset
recommendation.body: Approve `commentary` as the global narration-only mode and require a conflict-free branch, documented composition rules, and live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work spans both the durable commentary lane and shared progress architecture involved in this decision.
